The '''Garena Premier League Opening Event''' was the opening event of the [[Garena Premier League]] ('''GPL'''), held on May 5, 2012, offline in Taiwan. Six teams from Southeast Asia competed, with the Group Stage conducted as a Single Round Robin, best-of-one, and the top two teams from each group advancing to a Single Elimination, best-of-one Playoffs. The bottom team in each group was eliminated. The tournament offered a total prize pool of 5,000 {{Abbr/USD}}, with [[Taipei Assassins]] claiming first place. Other participants included [[Singapore Sentinels]], [[Saigon Jokers]], [[Bangkok Titans]], [[Manila Eagles]], and [[Kuala Lumpur Hunters]].
